Title: The Triplets Go to School

Macy, Stacy, and Tracy are triplets. They do everything together. Each morning they wake up and put on matching uniforms. Then, they get on their bicycles and ride to school. At school, they take all the same classes. Their first class is French. The triplets are bilingual because they already speak English and Spanish. Once they learn French, they will be trilingual! Their next class is math. In math class, they learn all about different kinds of triangles. Then, in music class they practice a new song. They always sing in unison at the biweekly show. After lunch, they go to reading class. This is the triplets’ favorite class. Their teacher is reading the last book in a new trilogy to them. They can not wait to learn how this story ends. At the end of the day, the triplets get back on their bicycles and ride home together. They are an unbreakable trio.

Title: Babies

Just like people, animals have babies. A human baby is called an infant. Monkey babies are also called infants. Monkeys carry their babies around just like people! Do you think they cry like human babies? A rabbit’s baby is called a bunny. Bunnies can also be called kittens. Does that remind you of another animal? That’s right! Cat babies are also called kittens. Female rabbits make a nest to keep the bunnies warm and safe. Female cats give birth to around four or five kittens at a time, but they can sometimes have as many as nine! A group of kittens is called a litter. You’ve probably seen a baby dog before. These babies are called puppies. Like kittens, group of puppies is called a a litter. A female dog may give birth to only one or maybe as many as seven or eight puppies in a litter. Like fish, baby birds come from an egg. The female bird lays eggs in a nest. She takes care of the eggs until they hatch. When they are first born, they’re called hatchlings. Which baby is your favorite? The furry ones like puppies, bunnies, or kittens? Or do you like insect babies like a maggot or a caterpillar? Or do you like the fishy fry baby? Or a feathered baby like a hatchling?

Title: A trek up the track

Mum and Nana send us on a trek up the track where
we can dig for ants.
Mum stops, “Can you spot the black ants, with strips of gold on
their backs?”
Mum clamps her hands on the long stick. “The ants are small, but
we must be strong when we dig.”
Mum has a rest on the crest of the pit.
Cram and sit in the pit. Flick and sift the sand with the long stick.
A clump of sand in the cup of her hands. Mum has the skill to get
the ants with the black and gold strips.
A quick pinch on their back. The trick is not to get a nip from the
ants.
“Thank you, mum!” I hold the ant and suck on my snack. Yum!

Title: Make and Take

Blaze and Slone are in a make and take class. Blaze looks at the list of things to make. “I would like to glitz up a frame. What do you want to do, Slone?” Slone looks at the list. “I would like to glaze a cake,” she says, “Do we have time to do these things?” “I think we do. Let’s sit here on this bench,” Blaze adds. Slone grabs the cake kit. She goes with a white and pink theme. She frosts the cake white. Then she pipes pink roses on the top. Blaze grabs the frame kit. They stick glass stones on the frame. Then they add shells. “The frame looks fab!” said Slone. “The cake looks grand!” said Blaze. Slone hands the cake to Blaze. “A gift for you,” she says with a smile. Blaze grins back and gifts Slone the frame.

Title: Catch me!

Dad went to fetch Chad for lunch.
He was on the bench in a patch of sun. “Chips for lunch!”
Chad did not want his lunch yet. “Catch me!”
The twigs went crunch as he ran.
Dad gave his chin a scratch. Where did Chad go?
He is such a quick kid!
Chad hid in a ditch. Dad ran to find him.
Dad was no match for Chad.
Chad crept from the ditch. This was so much fun!
Then Chad hid next to a big branch. Dad still did not find him!
Chad did a switch to trick Dad. He ran back to the bench.
“Come on Dad. Let’s go munch on some lunch!”
Chad had such fun with Dad.

Title: The Odd Plant

Jeff had a job tending to plants. One day, he was checking on a small red one that was planted in a big black pot. The pot was sitting on a bench. the day she was having the party she always wanted! Fay’s dad and grandma made a
list of things to do on a page in her writing tablet.
